sentences.text: IPMA lists 19 active weather warnings in 25 areas of Portugal, 7 orange and 12 yellow.
Orange or red warnings for rough sea are active in Aveiro, Braga, Coimbra, Leiria, Lisboa, Porto and Viana do Castelo.
IPMA forecasts waves of 3.7 to 5.1 metres from NW on the Porto coast on 2026-11-19, with sea temperature 16.7 to 16.8 °C.
IPMA forecasts a chance of rain of 100% today, 2026-11-18, in Lisboa, Porto, Faro, Coimbra and Évora.
Fire risk today is low in all 278 of Portugal's municipalities.
